description: Acceptance contract for the MDLineage validator. Each entry pins one fixture to the deterministic diagnostic codes its front matter must produce. Codes come from schemas/diagnostic-codes.json; layers follow docs/remark-language-server-solution.md §4. Cross-file rules (MDL301 duplicate id, MDL302 unresolved target, MDL303 ambiguity, MDL401/MDL402 cross-file links/anchors) are excluded from `expectedCodes` because they are not decidable from a single document; fixtures that exist to feed them carry `workspace: true` and are validated as a set instead. Rules emitted by the raw-buffer line-ending scan (MDL601/MDL602) and by remark's own Markdown lint rules are likewise outside the schema layer, so such fixtures carry `layers: [eol-scan]` (or similar) and an empty `expectedCodes`.

entries.description: Fully valid document: all fields, unicode alias 缓存有效期, strong relation with reason and evidence anchor.
Only the four required fields; optional fields are absent.
Unknown top-level front matter fields are preserved and never diagnosed (preserveUnknownTopLevelFields).
example_of is not a strong type, so reason is optional.
Strong relation with reason and evidence anchor whose target heading resolves cross-file (MDL402 only decidable at workspace layer).
Opening --- with no closing ---; the boundary scanner reports MDL001 before YAML parsing, so the schema layer sees no metadata and emits no schema codes.
Three-space indentation breaks the YAML mapping; unparseable, so no schema code applies.
No front matter and no mdlineage key while metadata.required is true.
tpoics and relationz are unknown fields inside the mdlineage namespace (additionalProperties: false).
id Docs.Bad_ID fails ^[a-z0-9]+(?:[.-][a-z0-9]+)*$.
Required id is absent.
kind and status both absent; one MDL102 per missing field.
refined_by is not in the v1 relation vocabulary (direction is fixed per type; inverse forms are never authored).
depends_on is a strong type and reason is absent; the if/then requirement fails as MDL102, and the workspace layer would additionally report MDL304.
Same (type, target) pair declared twice. Schema-valid, so the schema layer emits nothing; MDL202 comes from the single-document semantic layer.

evidence lacks the required leading # (`cache-key` instead of `#cache-key`) and fails the ^#\S+$ anchor pattern. This case is unaffected by the Unicode loosening of that pattern — the failure is the missing prefix, not the character class.
Target is a file path instead of a stable id; the workspace layer would also report MDL302.
schema: 2 is unsupported; the const 1 requirement fails.
topics contains an empty string, violating the non-empty item constraint.
evidence #no-such-heading is well formed (schema-valid) but resolves to no heading in the current document → MDL201 at the single-document semantic layer.
Mixed line endings (LF then CRLF) within one file → MDL601, produced by the raw-buffer scan, not the schema layer.
CRLF throughout → MDL602 (policy is LF); raw-buffer scan layer only.
Schema-valid on its own. As a set with dup-id-b.md it produces MDL301 (duplicate id) plus MDL302 (unresolvable target).
Second half of the MDL301 pair and the MDL302 source.
With cycle-b.md forms a supersedes cycle → MDL305 (cycles: forbidden).
Closes the forbidden cycle; its own relations are schema-valid.
